QuestInfo.name: Grendel's Library
QuestInfo.0: I am not sure if they'll understand, but I might as well try to explain and ask for help.
QuestInfo.1: Athena Pierce seemed skeptical about the whole inter-dimensional teleportation thing, but she's offered to help. Find Grendel the Really Old in Ellinia. He'll be the old guy.
QuestInfo.2: You asked Grendel the Really Old in Ellinia, about inter-dimensional teleportation and the Demon King, but he wasn't very helpful.
